name: Blog card
description: Post teaser: rounded image, date / category meta line, title (style h5, tag h3) in the primary text tone. No border or padding; the whole card is clickable via the title link.
avoidWhen: Products, listings or courses: use Listing card
A featured article with an excerpt and a button: use a section

examples.title: Grid of posts
examples.description: Three across from 1024px, two from 768px, one on phones.

examples.title: Without category
examples.description: Leave out the separator and category; the date stands alone.
